findings.label: Intrinsic-size tuning value
findings.detail: contain-intrinsic-size:0 300px shipped vs the design's 320px. A tuning value (design-review NIT), not a contract term. Validate at 360/390/414px during manual QA; no code change required to pass.

findings.label: Static sticky-bar cart badge
findings.detail: The sticky-bar cart button renders a hardcoded 0 badge with no live-count listener. Outside the contract, which only requires reusing data-cart-open (satisfied). Optional follow-up to sync it with the cart count.
